## One-sided Probability

```{ojs}
//| panel: sidebar
// 1. User Inputs
viewof mean = Inputs.number({label: "Mean (μ)", value: 0, step: 0.1});
viewof sd = Inputs.number({label: "Std. Dev. (σ)", value: 1, step: 0.1, min: 0.000001});
viewof direction = Inputs.radio(["Below (≤)", "Above (≥)"], {label: "Direction", value: "Below (≤)"});
viewof x_val = Inputs.number({label: "X value", value: 0, step: 0.01});
```

```{ojs}
//| panel: fill
// 2. Display the Interactive Plot
Plot.plot({
  grid: true,
  x: {domain: [mean - 4 * sd, mean + 4 * sd], label: ""},
  y: {label: "Density"},
  marks: [
    // Shaded Area representing the probability
    Plot.areaY(curveData.filter(d => direction === "Below (≤)" ? d.x <= x_val : d.x >= x_val), {
      x: "x",
      y: "y",
      fill: "#4682b4",
      fillOpacity: 0.4
    }),
    // The entire Normal Curve outline
    Plot.line(curveData, {x: "x", y: "y", stroke: "#1f77b4", strokeWidth: 4}),
    // Vertical line at the selected X value
    Plot.ruleX([x_val], {stroke: "red", strokeDasharray: "4 4"})
  ]
})
```

***

### **Result**

```{ojs}
// 3. Output the calculated probability
html`<div style="font-size: 1.4em; font-weight: bold; color: #2c3e50;">
  P(X ${direction === "Below (≤)" ? "≤" : "≥"} ${x_val}) = ${probability.toFixed(4)}
</div>`
```





## Two-sided Probability

```{ojs}
//| panel: sidebar
// 1. User Inputs
viewof mean2 = Inputs.number({label: "Mean (μ)", value: 0, step: 0.1});
viewof sd2 = Inputs.number({label: "Std. Dev. (σ)", value: 1, step: 0.1, min: 0.000001});
viewof x_val_lo = Inputs.number({label: "Lower Limit", value: 0, step: 0.01});
viewof x_val_hi = Inputs.number({label: "Upper Limit", value: 1, step: 0.01});
```

```{ojs}
//| panel: fill
// 2. Display the Interactive Plot
Plot.plot({
  grid: true,
  x: {domain: [mean2 - 4 * sd2, mean2 + 4 * sd2], label: ""},
  y: {label: "Density"},
  marks: [
    // Shaded Area representing the probability
    Plot.areaY(curveData2.filter(d => x_val_lo <= d.x  && d.x <= x_val_hi ), {
      x: "x",
      y: "y",
      fill: "#4682b4",
      fillOpacity: 0.4
    }),
    // The entire Normal Curve outline
    Plot.line(curveData2, {x: "x", y: "y", stroke: "#1f77b4", strokeWidth: 4}),
    // Vertical line at the selected X value
    Plot.ruleX([x_val_lo], {stroke: "red", strokeDasharray: "4 4"}),
    Plot.ruleX([x_val_hi], {stroke: "red", strokeDasharray: "4 4"})
  ]
})
```

***

### **Result**
```{ojs}
// 3. Output the calculated probability
html`<div style="font-size: 1.4em; font-weight: bold; color: #2c3e50;">
  P(${x_val_lo} ≤ X ≤ ${x_val_hi}) = ${probability2.toFixed(4)}
</div>`
```

:::

```{ojs}
// 4. Mathematical Helper Functions

// Normal Probability Density Function (PDF)
function normalPDF(x, mu, sigma) {
  return (1 / (sigma * Math.sqrt(2 * Math.PI))) * Math.exp(-0.5 * Math.pow((x - mu) / sigma, 2));
}

// Error Function (erf) approximation for Cumulative Distribution Function (CDF)
function erf(x) {
  const a1 =  0.254829592;
  const a2 = -0.284496736;
  const a3 =  1.421413741;
  const a4 = -1.453152027;
  const a5 =  1.061405429;
  const p  =  0.3275911;

  const sign = (x < 0) ? -1 : 1;
  const absX = Math.abs(x);

  const t = 1.0 / (1.0 + p * absX);
  const y = 1.0 - (((((a5 * t + a4) * t) + a3) * t + a2) * t + a1) * t * Math.exp(-absX * absX);

  return sign * y;
}

// Normal Cumulative Distribution Function (CDF)
function normalCDF(x, mu, sigma) {
  return 0.5 * (1 + erf((x - mu) / (sigma * Math.sqrt(2))));
}

// Generate coordinate points to draw the curve smoothly
curveData = {
  const points = [];
  const minX = mean - 4 * sd;
  const maxX = mean + 4 * sd;
  const steps = 200;
  const stepSize = (maxX - minX) / steps;
  
  for (let i = 0; i <= steps; i++) {
    let currentX = minX + i * stepSize;
    points.push({ x: currentX, y: normalPDF(currentX, mean, sd) });
  }
  return points;
}

// Calculate the final probability output dynamically
probability = {
  const pBelow = normalCDF(x_val, mean, sd);
  return direction === "Below (≤)" ? pBelow : 1 - pBelow;
}

curveData2 = {
  const points = [];
  const minX = mean2 - 4 * sd2;
  const maxX = mean2 + 4 * sd2;
  const steps = 200;
  const stepSize = (maxX - minX) / steps;
  
  for (let i = 0; i <= steps; i++) {
    let currentX = minX + i * stepSize;
    points.push({ x: currentX, y: normalPDF(currentX, mean2, sd2) });
  }
  return points;
}

probability2 = {
   const p2lo = normalCDF(x_val_lo, mean, sd);
   const p2hi = normalCDF(x_val_hi, mean, sd);
   return p2hi - p2lo;
}
```
